description: Phase 1: Sample Texts & Text-Level Etymology Analysis - Give every language a voice and port etymology-tree analytical capabilities into the web platform

userStories.title: Create sample-texts.tsv data file
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the sample texts TSV data file created and populated so that the system has representative text passages for languages.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lexicons/sample-texts.tsv with columns: id, language_id, title, text, transliteration, translation_en, source, date_composed, genre, script
Genre values: prose, poetry, religious, legal, inscription, conversational
Populate with 3 sample texts each for at least 15 major languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, Mandarin, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Turkish, Swahili, Greek
Populate with at least 1 sample text each for 10 dead/historical languages: Latin, Ancient Greek, Sanskrit, Old English, Old Norse, Gothic, Sumerian, Akkadian, Old Irish, Classical Chinese
Total minimum 55 sample text entries
All language_id values must match existing IDs in languages.tsv
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use real representative texts - opening lines of famous works, religious texts, inscriptions, proverbs. Include transliteration for non-Latin scripts.

userStories.title: Add sample texts TSV loader and API endpoints
userStories.description: As a developer, I need server-side loading and API endpoints for sample texts so the frontend can access them.
acceptanceCriteria: Add sample-texts TSV loading to server/tsv-storage.ts following existing patterns
Add GET /api/sample-texts endpoint returning all sample texts with optional query params: language_id, genre, script
Add GET /api/sample-texts/:id endpoint returning a single sample text
Add GET /api/languages/:id/sample-texts endpoint returning all texts for a specific language
Response includes all TSV fields parsed correctly
Register routes in server/routes.ts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add sample text viewer to language detail view
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see sample texts when viewing a language's details so I can see what the language looks like.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a 'Sample Texts' section/tab within the language detail view
Display original text with proper Unicode rendering
Show transliteration alongside text for non-Latin scripts (if available)
Show English translation in a toggleable/collapsible panel
Display metadata below each text: source, date composed, genre, script
Show empty state message when no sample texts exist for a language
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Create etymology-relations.tsv data file
userStories.description: As a developer, I need etymological derivation relationship data so the system can trace word origins across languages.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lexicons/etymology-relations.tsv with columns: id, source_word, source_language, target_word, target_language, relation_type
relation_type values: derived_from, etymology, cognate, borrowed_from, calque
Populate with at least 2000 etymological relationships
Include relationships tracing common English words back to Latin, Old French, Old English, Old Norse, Greek
Include at least 200 cognate relationships across Indo-European languages (e.g., English 'mother' / German 'Mutter' / Latin 'mater' / Sanskrit 'matar')
Include at least 100 borrowing relationships (e.g., English 'algebra' borrowed_from Arabic, English 'tsunami' borrowed_from Japanese)
Include at least 50 relationships involving non-Indo-European languages
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Model after the etymwn.tsv format from etymology-tree (rel:is_derived_from, rel:etymology, rel:etymological_origin_of) but normalized to our TSV schema.

userStories.title: Add etymology relations TSV loader and API endpoints
userStories.description: As a developer, I need server-side loading and API endpoints for etymology relations so the frontend can query them.
acceptanceCriteria: Add etymology-relations TSV loading to server/tsv-storage.ts
Add GET /api/etymology-relations endpoint with optional filters: source_language, target_language, relation_type
Add GET /api/etymology-relations/word/:word endpoint returning all relations for a given word
Register routes in server/routes.ts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add etymology trace service
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service that recursively traces a word's full etymology chain (like trace-etymology in the Clojure etymology-tree project).
acceptanceCriteria: Create server/services/etymology-trace.ts
Implement traceEtymology(word, language) function that recursively follows derived_from and etymology relations to find all ancestor words
Implement traceDescendants(word, language) function that follows relations in reverse to find all descendant words
Handle circular references with a visited-set (same approach as etymology-tree)
Return results as a tree structure: { word, language, relation, children: [...] }
Add GET /api/etymology-relations/trace/:word endpoint that returns the full trace tree
Add optional query param ?language= to disambiguate homographs
Register route in server/routes.ts
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reference etymology-tree/src/stylometry/core.clj trace-etymology function for the recursive pattern.

userStories.title: Add text tokenization and origin frequency service
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service that tokenizes a text and computes what percentage of words come from each origin language (like word-origin-frequencies in etymology-tree).
acceptanceCriteria: Create server/services/text-etymology-analyzer.ts
Implement tokenize(text, language) function that splits text into words and normalizes them

Implement analyzeTextOrigins(text, language) function that: tokenizes the text, looks up each word's etymology chain, traces each to its oldest known ancestor, groups by origin language, returns frequency counts and percentages
Return structure: { totalWords, analyzedWords, unknownWords, origins: [{ language, languageName, count, percentage, words: string[] }] }
Handle unknown words gracefully (categorized as 'Unknown origin')
Add POST /api/text-analysis/origins endpoint accepting { text, language } body
Register route in server/routes.ts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add Text Analyzer page with text input
userStories.description: As a user, I want a Text Analyzer page where I can paste text and select a source language to analyze its etymological composition.
acceptanceCriteria: Add new 'Text Analyzer' page accessible from main navigation
Text input area (textarea) for pasting text
Language selector dropdown defaulting to English
Analyze button that calls POST /api/text-analysis/origins
Loading state while analysis runs
Add route in client App.tsx
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add etymology origin breakdown chart to Text Analyzer
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a pie/donut chart showing the percentage breakdown of vocabulary origins after analyzing a text.
acceptanceCriteria: Display results as a donut chart (using Recharts PieChart) with segments colored by origin language
Each segment labeled with language name and percentage
Legend showing all origin languages with colors and word counts
Summary text: e.g. '423 of 500 words analyzed, 77 unknown'
Clicking a chart segment expands to show the list of specific words from that origin
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add word-level etymology highlighting to Text Analyzer
userStories.description: As a user, I want to hover over any word in my analyzed text and see its etymology chain highlighted inline.
acceptanceCriteria: After analysis, display the original text with each word as a hoverable span
Words colored by their origin language (matching the donut chart colors)
Hover tooltip shows: word -> derived from X (language) -> derived from Y (language) -> ... -> root word (origin language)
Unknown words shown in gray with 'Unknown origin' tooltip
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add quick-analyze button for sample texts
userStories.description: As a user, I want to analyze any sample text from the language detail view with a single click, sending it to the Text Analyzer pre-filled.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'Analyze Etymology' button next to each sample text in the language detail view
Clicking navigates to Text Analyzer page with text and language pre-filled
Analysis runs automatically on page load when pre-filled via URL params or navigation state
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add etymology tree D3 visualization
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a visual tree showing how a word has traveled across languages, with nodes for each word form and edges for derivation relationships.
acceptanceCriteria: New EtymologyTreeVisualization component using D3.js tree layout
Nodes represent word forms labeled with word and language name
Edges represent derivation relationships labeled with relation type
Nodes colored by language family
Click any node to recenter the tree on that word (triggers new trace API call)
Zoom and pan support
Accessible from Text Analyzer (click any word) and from a standalone 'Word Etymology' search
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add etymology tree export
userStories.description: As a user, I want to export the etymology tree visualization as SVG or PNG.
acceptanceCriteria: Add export button to etymology tree visualization with SVG and PNG options
Reuse existing export utilities from client/src/lib/visualization/export.ts
Exported image includes the full visible tree with labels
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add comparative text analysis endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an endpoint that analyzes two texts and returns their etymological compositions side-by-side with a comparison summary.
acceptanceCriteria: Add POST /api/text-analysis/compare endpoint accepting { textA, textB, languageA, languageB } body
Returns both analyses plus a comparison object: { sharedOrigins, uniqueToA, uniqueToB, differences: [{ language, percentA, percentB, diff }] }
Differences sorted by absolute difference descending
Register route in server/routes.ts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add comparative text analysis UI
userStories.description: As a user, I want to compare the etymological composition of two texts side-by-side.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'Compare' tab or toggle in the Text Analyzer page
Side-by-side text input areas with independent language selectors
Dual donut charts with synchronized color coding (same origin language = same color in both charts)
Difference summary below charts: e.g. 'Text A has 15% more Latin-origin words than Text B'
Shared vs unique origin languages highlighted in a table
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Expand sample texts to 50 languages
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to expand the sample texts dataset to cover more languages for broader coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: Add sample texts for at least 35 additional languages beyond the initial 25 from US-001

Include: Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Polish, Czech, Romanian, Hungarian, Finnish, Estonian, Georgian, Armenian, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Thai, Vietnamese, Burmese, Khmer, Indonesian, Tagalog, Yoruba, Zulu, Amharic, Hausa, Quechua, Nahuatl, Hawaiian, Maori, Tibetan, Mongolian, Basque
At least 2 texts per language
Add 10 more dead/historical language texts: Middle English, Old French, Old Persian, Coptic, Hittite, Avestan, Old Church Slavonic, Egyptian (hieroglyphic), Phoenician, Tocharian
Total sample texts reaches at least 150 entries
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is a data expansion story - focus on creating high-quality, real sample texts with proper transliterations.

userStories.title: Expand etymology relations to 5000+
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to expand the etymology relations dataset for better text analysis coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: Expand lexicons/etymology-relations.tsv to at least 5000 entries
Add at least 1000 more English word etymologies covering common vocabulary (top 3000 English words should have coverage)
Add at least 500 cognate sets across Romance languages
Add at least 500 cognate sets across Germanic languages
Add at least 300 borrowing relationships from Arabic, Persian, Sanskrit, Chinese, Japanese into other languages
Add at least 200 relationships involving Slavic languages
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is a data expansion story. Focus on breadth of English coverage first (since English text analysis is the primary use case), then cross-language cognates.
